# QR code (`qr-code`)

QR code for links and pairing.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createQrCode` (types in `dist/web/data-display/qrCode.d.ts`): `figure.mh-qr-code` (`--sm | --lg`): a QR code as an SVG (`role="img"`, named by `label`) with a `.mh-qr-code__plate` and `.mh-qr-code__modules`, and an optional `figcaption.mh-qr-code__caption`. The code is always dark ink on a light plate, taken from the theme's text and surface colours, so cameras read it in dark themes too; the quiet zone is part of the plate.

```ts
export function createQrCode(options: QrCodeOptions): QrCodeHandle;

export interface QrCodeOptions {
  /** The text or link to encode (UTF-8, byte mode). */
  value: string;
  /** Accessible name ("Link to the guest Wi-Fi page"). Default "QR code". */
  label?: string;
  /** A visible line under the code ("Scan with your phone"). */
  caption?: string;
  /** Error correction level; default `M`. Use `H` when part of the code may be covered or worn. */
  ecc?: QrEcc;
  /** Default `medium`; sizes follow the device class. */
  size?: QrCodeSize;
  /** Light modules around the code, in modules; default 4 (the spec's minimum). */
  quietZone?: number;
}

export interface QrCodeHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  /** The encoded matrix (version, level, mask, modules). */
  matrix(): QrMatrix;
}
```

`createTextField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/textField.d.ts`): `.mh-input` (`--sm | --lg`) inside a `.mh-field`: a single-line text input with an optional icon, prefix, suffix and counter. States: `:focus-within`, `[aria-invalid]`, `:disabled`. Height follows `--mh-control-*`.

```ts
export function createTextField(options: TextFieldOptions): TextFieldHandle;

export interface TextFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`; the field then renders the box alone. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  type?: TextFieldType;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  success?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** A leading icon (decorative). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Text before the value, e.g. a currency sign. */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Text after the value, e.g. a unit. */
  suffix?: string;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Shows a character counter (with `maxLength`, `n / max`). */
  showCount?: boolean;
  autocomplete?: string;
  inputMode?: string;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface TextFieldHandle {
  /** The field (or the bare box without a label). */
  el: HTMLElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createQrCode, createTextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const start = 'https://homeassistant.local:8123/';

const code = createQrCode({
  value: start,
  label: 'Link to the dashboard',
  caption: 'Open on your phone',
});

const field = createTextField({
  label: 'Link',
  value: start,
  onInput: (value) => code.setValue(value),
});

document.body.append(field.el, code.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { QrCode, TextField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function QrCodeExample() {
  const [link, setLink] = useState('https://homeassistant.local:8123/');
  return (
    <>
      <TextField label="Link" value={link} onChange={(event) => setLink(event.target.value)} />
      <QrCode value={link} label="Link to the dashboard" caption="Open on your phone" />
    </>
  );
}
```
